attributes.name: Venomous Buckler Gun
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+1d12+2 and add the Poison and Ranged traits; this counts as playing a weapon instead of an armor.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat or Poison damage dealt to you by 3. If proficient with light armors, you may play another armor on this check.
